title: Military official hounded by red-tagging, rights cases faces CA
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Questions on alleged red-tagging and human rights violations hounded a military official when he faced his confirmation hearing before the Commission on Appointments (CA) on…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Questions on alleged red-tagging and human rights violations hounded a military official when he faced his confirmation hearing before the Commission on Appointments (CA) on Friday. Sen. Risa Hontiveros raised the issues during the CA’s Committee on National Defense hearing, asking Army Maj. Gen. Joey Escanillas to respond to allegations contained in sworn oppositions filed against his appointment. The opposition, filed by members of the Community Empowerment Resource Network (Cernet), questioned Escanillas’ role in a terrorism financing case filed against the organization’s board members and staff.
